message: workflow V_wf: the node graph has a cycle — V_chain
why: The IR must be a DAG (IR.md V-3). With a cycle the executor can re-enter the same node forever, so neither a deadline nor a budget can bound the run — it would be killed from outside instead of stopping itself.
fix: break the cycle by removing the edge V_edge
if you need repetition, use `retry` — it is bounded, and the graph itself must stay acyclic
